name: EvalAgent
bio: Scores the tuned model against the base model (zero-shot and few-shot) and a teacher on the frozen benchmark, plus general ability and safety. Takes: adapter_path, bench_dir. Gives: eval_report_path.
_note: Reacts only to hand-off artifacts (no interests). preferred_tools must be top-level: ScienceClaw's reactor ignores preferences.tools. Run with scripts/run_agents.py, which adds investigation_id per pipeline.
